root_draft.speaker: agent
root_draft.text: Stillsand is an apparently empty ocean of sand beneath an unsetting sun, where crossing the open ground is an expedition and a giant can be moving geography. Rock islands offer harbours; reaching their shade and exploring their caves can change what the colony can afford to do next. Wind, moving sand, tracks and buried life make that emptiness active: water and blood wake what was hidden, approaching creatures leave signs, and a dune gale offers relief from the sun while moving the ground and threatening exposed travellers. The same relentless sunlight powers a useful trade in fine sand, glass, lenses, cooking and recovered water. Giant remains and what the wind uncovers give the place a history. The franchise-free biome carries this experience itself; the campaign layer adds its canon creatures and Sun-Debt faith. Its heat must obey the shared geometry of Direct Sun, its losses must be readable, and its machinery must remain usable as a colony grows.

failure_modes: F1: The ocean of nothing becomes a busy zoo or a set of unrelated attractions, and rock islands, living giants and precious caves no longer organise the crossing. Sources: design/RimMandrake/biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md:22; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/stillsand_bedazzle_2026-09-27.md.

F2: The desert cheats: refuge and warning do not match danger, a pawn or its body disappears without an honest sign, or cave and storm rewards promise things the colony cannot reach or use. Sources: src/RimMandrake/Stillsand/Source/RM_HorizonWarning.cs:118; src/RimMandrake/Stillsand/Source/RM_SolarStill.cs:146; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/stillsand_turn3_development_2026-09-30.md.

F3: The connected systems fail in routine play: old sunlight regimes contradict shared rules, water is lost or counted wrongly, jobs stall, or reload/settings and destructive proof fixtures leave state behind. Sources: OWNER:1792410399049610407; OWNER:1793794389686592719; src/RimMandrake/Stillsand/validation.py:495; src/RimMandrake/Stillsand/Source/RM_Verb_MirrorBeam.cs:357.

neighbours.text: MovingDunes owns transport, wind bearing, depth, burial caches, clear yield and committed SandMoved events. Stillsand supplies gale/weather/material bindings and track erasure, not another sand store.

CreatureBehaviors owns sand-swim state, droid target filter, shared shade/pinned sun/heat, tracks, drum lure, filter feed, shadow following and shade-driven severity. Stillsand opts in and supplies content, sounds, thumper/geophone and event control.

FlowWorks owns deep-sand terrain and shared TakenByLand lifecycle; spill/growth wetting must agree with Stillsand wet state. DBH optionally owns real thirst jobs/bottles; RM water items still function without it.
EnvironmentalHazards provides set-piece element vocabulary and arrival service; Stillsand owns its rare rock/cave context and rows. ProximityHatch owns hatch-on-approach behaviour when loaded.

SWBestiary, Sarlacc and Utinni own canon species/quest data/rooting/faith; Stillsand engine remains useful without them. LongHunger Groundcaller consumes thumper comp; that patch alone does not prove a summon.
HugeThings owns giant physical footprints and titan corpse sites. Its queued T3 conversion and Stillsand seasonal skeleton conversion require an interaction scene, not assumed compatibility.
LongShade source still supplies Ulgga, Vosska and Ultriss Pad while their native wild home is Stillsand. Composition resolves that file ownership; do not mistake the folder for a roster assignment.
Wreckage owns salvage jobs and loot/weathering; Acoustic Scanner owns ship-side scanning. The geophone is local coarse listening and does not replace either.
